=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:354-363, 385-387 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new config_override detection ignores `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` / `GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n` / `GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_n` environment-based configuration, which can also redirect `remote.origin.url`.
  WHY: Environment-based Git config overrides are equivalent to `-c` for redirecting push destinations, so the guard consults the wrong origin and authorizes a cross-repo push.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:459-470 (_push_targets) | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `--push-option=`/`--push-o=`/`--pu=` are added to the value-option branch, but these are push options (not remotes); the other added equals-forms (`--push-o=`, `--pu=`, `--rece=`, `--e=`) consume a value via the `word.startswith(...)` branch without advancing `index`, so the value is not skipped and may be misread as a positional remote/refspec.
  WHY: A push like `git push --push-o=foo origin HEAD:feature/x` would have `origin` parsed but the `--push-o=foo` token's equals-form handling differs from the prior behavior; the prior code treated these as pass-through. The regression is minor (these are rare), but the new branch duplicates `--push-option=` handling while the equals-forms `--push-o=`/`--pu=`/`--rece=`/`--e=` now silently consume the next token differently.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:473-516 (_push_targets, deletion-only path) | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When `delete=True` and `remote_value` is empty/non-origin, the function returns `[]` (no target); when `remote_provided=False` and `positionals` is empty (e.g. `git push --delete` with no refspec), `remote_value` stays `""` and the `else []` branch returns nothing, so the deletion is silently allowed without any check.
  WHY: `git push --delete` without a refspec/remote deletes the upstream tracking ref on origin; the guard returns `[]` and does not ask. This matches prior behavior for `origin` deletions (intentional), so this is not a regression.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
